research_question: When S2 and S4 remain uninformative after personal calibration, is the limiting mechanism calibration order statistics, subject baseline mismatch, a misleading sensor family, or the classifier representation?
limitations: The k=18 to k=19 transition is only one order-statistic boundary with at most 20 onboarding examples.
S2 and S4 remain post-selected exploratory cases.
Sensor-family ablation diagnoses predictive interference, not physical sensor malfunction.
The nonlinear models use fixed untuned NumPy implementations and are not exhaustive.
One dataset and one recording session per subject limit external validity.
